items.source: Dedicated PlatformTransactionManager for native Neo4j transactions.
items.translation: 专为原生 Neo4j 事务提供的 PlatformTransactionManager。

items.source: A builder for Neo4jTransactionManager.
items.translation: 用于构建Neo4jTransactionManager的类。

items.source: Neo4j specific implementation of an AbstractReactiveTransactionManager.
items.translation: Neo4j 对 AbstractReactiveTransactionManager 的具体实现。

items.source:
<!-- tag::intent[] --> Contains the core infrastructure for translating unmanaged Neo4j
transaction into Spring managed transactions. Exposes both the imperative and reactive
`TransactionManager` as `Neo4jTransactionManager` and
`ReactiveNeo4jTransactionManager`. <!-- end::intent[] -->
items.translation: <!-- tag::intent[] --> 包含将未管理的 Neo4j 事务转换为 Spring 管理事务的核心基础设施。提供命令式和响应式 `TransactionManager`，分别以 `Neo4jTransactionManager` 和 `ReactiveNeo4jTransactionManager` 的形式暴露。<!-- end::intent[] -->

items.source:
This package contains the core infrastructure for creating an
imperative or reactive client that can execute queries.
items.translation: 该包提供了创建可执行查询的指令式或响应式客户端的核心基础设施。

items.source: Provides a set of simples types that SDN supports.
items.translation: 提供了一组 SDN 支持的简单类型。

items.source:
This package contains the schema that is defined by a set of classes, representing
nodes and relationships and their properties.
items.translation: 该包包含由一组类定义的架构，这些类表示节点、关系及其属性。

items.source:
This package provides a couple of support classes that might be
helpful in your domain, for example a predicate indicating that some transaction may be
retried and additional converters and id generators.
items.translation: 该包提供了一些可能对您领域有帮助的支持类，例如指示某些事务可重试的谓词，以及额外的转换器和 ID 生成器。

items.source: Responsible for storing, updating and retrieving the bookmarks of Neo4j's transaction.
items.translation: 负责存储、更新和检索 Neo4j 事务的书签。

items.source:
This event will be published after a Neo4j transaction manager physically committed a
transaction without errors and received a new set of bookmarks from the cluster.
items.translation: 该事件将在 Neo4j 事务管理器无错误地物理提交事务并从集群接收到新的一组书签后发布。
